note: Pinned ws-options-verify failures per skill (IMPROVEMENT_PLAN §1.4 S1: red gates compare with a pinned baseline). Each entry is option=<JSON value> (as ws-options-verify prints it) or static:<message>. ws-precritic fails on any failing pair not listed here, and on any failure of a skill not listed. Remove a pair when its defect is fixed; never add one to make a new failure pass without a STATUS note.
how: node tests/scripts/ws-options-pin.cjs --write (every live skill: ws-options-verify --skill <batch ids> --deadline 600000 --json per batch of 25, two batches at a time through /tmp/mq-browser-run.sh; a verifier timeout is re-run on its own); --write --skills cat:skill,... re-pins a subset; --check compares a fresh run with this pin. The skills that need more than ws-options-verify's 60 s default deadline time out under a plain run: pass --deadline 600000.
